unavailable_fields.per_operator_peak_allocated_attribution: No available collector attributes the process-level PyTorch allocator peak to individual operators or tensors: the already-run torch discovery trace was captured with profile_memory=False, and execution_timeline records shapes, intervals and synchronization only.
unavailable_fields.clean_objective_samples_from_diagnostics: peak_allocated_bytes and images_per_second are only cleanly sampled by the evaluation harness around one infer() call with reset_peak_memory_stats; every diagnostic collector is a separate perturbed run and cannot serve as objective or constraint scores.
unavailable_fields.device_memory_vs_process_allocated_break: device_telemetry is not applicable: request communication is off (collector returns not_applicable) and NVML readings are device-wide samples with native windows, not per-forward PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks.
unavailable_fields.nccl_algorithm_protocol_channels: nccl_tuning is not applicable: communication disabled and single-device task; observations.json reports communication not_applicable (reason: disabled) and coverage.json shows no communication kernels among the 86 associated kernels.
unavailable_fields.collective_reference_allreduce: collective_calibration is not applicable: communication disabled; the task is single-GPU inference memory reduction with no collectives to calibrate.
unavailable_fields.nsys_overlap_or_graph_attribution: nsys not requested: coverage.json shows 86 of 86 kernels associated with 0 unassociated, 0 root-only and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so no overlap, CUDA-graph tracing or attribution question is open; nsys additionally cannot attribute PyTorch allocator peaks.
unavailable_fields.host_dispatch_self_costs: python_runtime not selected: its warmed cProfile perturbs execution and inclusive/self times are neither clean performance scores nor GPU durations; the dispatch share relevant to the images_per_second constraint is observable as execution_timeline gaps_between_kernels_us.
unavailable_fields.candidate_guard_and_exception_trace: candidate_diagnostics is not applicable at planning time: the current revision b80beb0f2b66335af9bbdb747b6d4f80f26c33d46a7eed567199abff983dc33a has no candidate bundles; it is collected during candidate trials once installers exist.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion remain unknown, retained as unknown rather than inferred.
unavailable_fields.pcie_nvlink_traffic_bytes: Communication is off and no collector measures per-collective wire bytes; PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes.

rationale: The frozen objective is minimizing peak_allocated_bytes for one batch-32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward on a single GPU (communication off, pure inference: coverage.json shows 86 CUDA kernels all associated, 0 autograd ranges, 0 backward kernels), under an images_per_second >= 0.95*baseline constraint. The torch collector already ran and is owned by execution discovery, so it is not re-requested. execution_timeline is selected because it is the one available collector that runs for this communication-off single-device task and informs both sides of the problem: its separate plain (non-hook) warmed Torch trace with record_shapes=True yields per-device kernel_count, kernel_span_us, kernel_active_union_us and gaps_between_kernels_us, which establish how much dispatch headroom exists before memory-oriented restructuring (for example micro-batched or chunked execution that adds launches and synchronization) would violate the throughput constraint; copies_and_memsets and cuda_synchronization locate D2D copies and sync placement such restructuring would add; and the recorded per-call input shapes support an activation-footprint inventory of the forward to rank candidate peak-memory contributors analytically from observed shapes, since no collector measures per-operator allocation directly. nsys is deliberately not selected: with 0 unassociated and 0 ambiguous kernels there is no open attribution, graph-tracing or overlap question it would resolve, and it cannot attribute allocator peaks. nccl_tuning, device_telemetry and collective_calibration are not applicable because communication is disabled on this single-device task. candidate_diagnostics has no candidate bundles to trace at this revision. python_runtime is skipped as a perturbing, non-scoring diagnostic whose only relevant signal (dispatch share) is covered by timeline gaps. Remaining unknowns are listed with observed reasons rather than filled by inference.
